goal:
Users land on yara.garden, navigate to the yara character, and initiate a conversation with her.

Founder clarification (answering Sage's question): A successful tester should complete onboarding, enter the main walkable garden, locate the in-world Yara character—not the scripted opening dialogue—open her conversation, send a non-sensitive test message, and receive a new response from Yara. Evidence should include what the tester sent and the new reply they received.
